en.headline: Two arrested for providing illegal tour guide and photography services
en.dek: The Immigration Department and Travel Industry Authority conducted a two-day operation targeting mainland visitors who offered the services via social media.
body: The Immigration Department jointly with the Travel Industry Authority arrested two women, aged 22 and 31, during a two-day anti-illegal worker operation on 27 and 28 July targeting people providing unlicensed tour guide and photography services.

Authorities said the suspects, who entered Hong Kong as visitors, promoted the services on social media platforms. Officers used undercover enquiries to arrange meetings and made the arrests when the pair arrived to provide the services.

The Immigration Department is considering prosecution for breach of conditions of stay. Officers also distributed leaflets at tourist spots reminding the public not to hire illegal guides. Offenders face a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and two years' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 入境處聯同旅監局拘兩人涉非法提供導遊及攝影服務
zh.dek: 兩名年齡22歲及31歲女子以旅客身份在社交平台招攬生意，於放蛇行動中被捕，入境處考慮檢控。
body: 入境事務處聯同旅遊業監管局於7月27日及28日一連兩日展開反非法勞工行動，拘捕兩名年齡分別22歲及31歲的女子，她們涉嫌以旅客身份提供非法導遊及攝影服務。
當局表示，涉事女子在社交平台宣傳服務，執法人員透過網上放蛇聯絡並約見，於對方到場提供服務時將其拘捕。
入境處正考慮以違反逗留條件檢控。人員亦在旅遊熱點派發單張，提醒市民及旅客切勿僱用非法導遊。違例者最高可被罰款5萬元及監禁兩年。
